metadata.note: Named shared physical arterials and gateways from the modeled route union. Necessary unnamed OSM mid-route connectors remain load-bearing in baseline.json but are intentionally omitted here, as are terminal, forced and aggregated-zone-portal access chains, plus the full internal district street network. Visible contextOnly features are named-spine references and are closed to assignment.
